oracle.method: For every listed frame, a native x86_64 C harness zero-initialized one HSD_FObj with the exact descriptor start frame, channel and scalar encodings plus the exact program bytes; called HSD_FObjReqAnimAll followed by HSD_FObjInterpretAnim at rate 0; required exactly one update callback; and copied the callback f32 to value_bits. Native pointers widen the pointer fields, but the scalar field order and types and the pinned algorithms are unchanged. Host agreement does not establish PowerPC or whole-game equivalence.
